description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
配置备份导出任务ID。
> 该参数为调用CreateExportConfigJob接口创建配置备份导出任务成功后的返回参数JobId。
description.en:
The ID of the configuration backup export job.

> This parameter is the JobId returned after you successfully call the CreateExportConfigJob operation to create a configuration backup export job.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 获取配置备份导出任务详情（仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用）

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-export-config-job --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
